tasks.short: Count containers and read their labels at the disposal site, write numbers, types and weights in the waste log, copy the log into the waste register, and reconcile amounts with the site's weighing slips.

steps.what: Hazmat removal worker counts containers stored at the disposal site: reading each label today, scanning its barcode after the change
Hazmat removal worker records numbers, types and amounts of waste disposed in the paper waste log
Hazmat removal worker copies the waste log into the company's waste register spreadsheet
Hazmat removal worker reconciles recorded amounts with the disposal site's weighing slips

tasks.design: Containers get a barcode label at packing with the waste type and packed weight, and scanning them at the disposal site with a phone app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) records number, type and weight in the waste register, so labels are not read and copied into a paper log and a spreadsheet; containers labelled by hand, about 20%, are still entered. Weighing data from the site are matched to containers by fixed rules, and the worker looks only at differences.
tasks.previous_blocker: Labels were read and copied by hand into logs and spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Phone apps scan container barcodes into a waste register.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged or wet labels do not scan.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting a leaking container before it is stored.
tasks.altitude: The worker checks differences instead of copying numbers.

evidence.claim: Phone apps can scan container barcodes into a waste register with type and weight.
Hazardous waste must be registered and traceable from packing to disposal under national rules.

assumptions: Boundary: from containers delivered to amounts reconciled; transport documents are outside.
Input contract: barcode labels printed at packing; fallback is the paper log.

Scenario: about 80% of containers carry barcode labels; the rest are labelled by hand. Walking to and counting each container stays, so s1 keeps 85: a scan replaces reading the label text. s2 keeps 45 for entering the hand-labelled containers and checking the scanned list; s3 keeps 20 for checking the register; s4 keeps 60 for looking at differences.
Disposal site staff's time does not change.
research_questions: Do differences with weighing slips fall?

incremental.description: Hazmat removal worker prints and attaches barcode labels at packing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: only half of containers carry barcode labels, so more are read and entered by hand (35.9); high: about 80% carry barcode labels as assumed (44.0).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review soil data and the remediation plan, apply bioremediation treatment, take soil samples and readings, and record them on field forms.

steps.what: Hazmat removal worker reviews soil lab results and the remediation plan from PDF reports
Hazmat removal worker applies bioremediation techniques to hazardous wastes
Hazmat removal worker takes soil samples and field readings
Hazmat removal worker records readings and sample details: on paper field forms today, on a tablet form with sample number and location filled in after the change

tasks.design: Lab results and the treatment plan are shown per location as tables and a site map in the project app ({OPS_SYSTEM}), so the worker does not search PDF reports. Readings and samples are entered on a tablet field form with sample number and location filled in, instead of paper forms; the worker still writes every reading. Applying treatment and sampling stay with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results came as PDF reports and readings were written on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Project apps show lab data per location and take field forms.
tasks.still_hard: Labs deliver results in different formats.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing from the soil that treatment is not taking hold.

evidence.claim: Field data apps can show lab results per location and take readings with sample number and location.
Soil remediation follows the approved remediation plan under national rules.

assumptions: Boundary: from the treatment due to readings recorded; remediation design is outside.
Input contract: lab results loaded into the project app; fallback is PDF reports and paper.

Treatment and sampling keep their full time. Readings and sample details are first records, so s4 keeps 90: only writing the sample number and location goes. s1 keeps 60 because results per location replace searching PDF reports; reading them and the plan stays.
research_questions: Are readings complete at each round?

incremental.description: Hazmat removal worker corrects readings entered at the wrong location.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the lab's results are not loaded into the project app, so the worker reads PDF reports as today (1.0); high: results loaded per location (7.0).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The hazmat removal worker keeps handling waste, applying treatment and sampling; copied labels, paper logs, spreadsheets and paper field forms shrink.
skills_to_grow: Scanning containers into the waste register
role.ambitious_version: A worker with more time on safe handling.
